rationale: C21 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. The child closely reproduces C21's distinctive description of the Secretary of State as the President's adviser in the formulation and control of foreign policy and as the executive branch channel of authority, while also preserving the parallel roles of the Secretaries of Defense and Treasury. It further adapts C21's machinery for foreign-policy conformity, interagency coordination, use of the Foreign Operations Administration, and authority of diplomatic mission chiefs. C02 is a strong secondary source for the detailed mission-chief coordination machinery, and C13 is a plausible structural model for establishing an interagency committee by presidential letter, but neither matches the child's distinctive language as closely as C21.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I wish to re-emphasize that the Secretary of State is the officer responsible for advising and assisting me in the formulation and control of foreign policy. I look to him as the channel of authority within the executive branch on foreign policy as I do to the Secretaries of Defense and Treasury in their respective fields.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I personally wish to emphasize that I shall regard the Secretary of State as the Cabinet officer responsible for advising and assisting me in the formulation and control of foreign policy. It will be my practice to employ the Secretary of State as my channel of authority within the executive branch on foreign policy. ... I shall also look to the Secretary of Defense ... Similarly, the Secretary of the Treasury...
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, closely parallel language preserving the same formulation-and-control concept, channel-of-authority phrase, and comparison with Defense and Treasury.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This program must be carried out in accordance with and in furtherance of our foreign policy objectives.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Foreign Operations Administration and the United States Information Agency must seek such guidance and establish appropriate means of assuring that its programs at all times conform to such foreign policy guidance.
shared_material.explanation: Both prescribe foreign-policy conformity for operating programs, using closely related administrative machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Under those instructions, the chief of the diplomatic mission is the principal officer of the United States in each country and has full responsibility and authority for assuring effective action in that country.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Chief of the United States diplomatic mission in each foreign country must provide effective coordination of, and foreign policy direction with respect to, all United States Government activities in the country.
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly invokes previous instructions and adapts C21's assignment of country-level coordination and foreign-policy authority to mission chiefs.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I shah expect the Secretary of Agriculture to utilize to the maximum extent practicable the facilities, services and experience of the Foreign Operations Administration.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Director of the Foreign Operations Administration should take full advantage of the advice and assistance available in other agencies. He should coordinate his operations with related operations in other agencies.
shared_material.explanation: The direction of assistance is reversed, but both use the same interagency-support mechanism centered on the Foreign Operations Administration.
